title: Mara and the Postcards
author: Sebastian Quintana
blurb: Bram Zhou, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
